title: What we’re learning from firms engaging with our innovation services
summary: Three themes stand out: the growing use of AI, innovation crossing traditional sector boundaries, and financial inclusion.As firms develop new products, services and business models, many engage with us through our Regulatory Sandbox and Innovation Pathways to understand how regulation applies to their proposition or to test innovative ideas in a controlled environment.Looking across applications lets us observe emerging trends.
